xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF for GitHub issue #3614 bound remedy: authorize every ApplyPatch mutation path, not only the declared write target

plan.title: BLOCKER: authorize every apply_patch mutation path, not only the declared write target

narratives.Description: The write gate authorizes the path a caller declares. It does not authorize the paths the patch body mutates. Close that bypass first; then restore the Codex proposal-write convenience by wiring the existing extractor, not a second parser.
narratives.Origin: Ingested from https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/3614. Bound by design-critique synthesis 5470534026, successor lean 5470524226, verified-claims table 5470530094, critic 5470424065.
narratives.Overview:
Bound contract: issue #3614 reported a Codex proposal write denied because hookWriteTargetPath does not read Add File from a raw apply_patch body. The design-critique arc found a larger live defect: the same path is bypassable on master today. A payload may declare path: xbrief/proposed/ while the patch body writes .github/workflows/release.yml or src/index.ts, and the gate returns allow / write-propose-ready. With the path-write fence enabled and those paths in denyPaths, a direct Write denies while the ApplyPatch form still allows.

Priority 1: every path hookMutationTargetPaths returns must be authorized. Mixed patches deny unless every target is allowed. Empty enumeration on an ApplyPatch-shaped payload fails closed. Shapes: single-file mismatch, 3-file mixed, Delete File, fence denyPaths vs direct Write.

Priority 2: Move to is two targets. Authorize source and destination, or deny.

Priority 3: dispatcher.test.ts currently asserts allow on a payload whose declared path and patch target disagree. Flip to deny. Record as a deliberate #3156 product fix of a test that pinned a defect, not a gate weakened to go green.

Priority 4: trySynthesizeFreeFormApplyPatch already implements the issue body recommended items 1-4. Reach it for valid-JSON hosts. Do not add a second parser. Synthesis refuses when applyPatchMutationPaths reports more than one unique path.

Priority 5: file a durable CLI-verb-keyed proposal-exemption follow-up. deft xbrief:create already works via fail-open (shell-op-unclassifiable). Do not expand text parsing in this scope.

Residual: vendor apply_patch grammar is not in this repository. If the matched operation set is incomplete, retire the text-parsed exemption rather than extend the parser by guesswork.

Out of scope: expanding the grammar matcher; implementing the verb-keyed exemption (file only); occupancy / #3611.
narratives.UserStory: As a consumer who opted into the path-write fence, I need ApplyPatch to be refused on every path the patch actually mutates, so declaring a planning file cannot smuggle a write into .github/ or src/.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Route the proposed-lifecycle exemption and the write-fence / authz checks through hookMutationTargetPaths. 2. Keep Move to destinations in that enumeration. 3. Flip the mismatched-path regression to deny and record #3156. 4. After JSON.parse, call existing trySynthesizeFreeFormApplyPatch on the patch body when no declared path is present; refuse synthesis when mutation paths are not exactly one. 5. File a follow-up issue for verb-keyed proposal exemption.
